nodes.label: Decision 1 — Elysia + Eden Treaty RPC bridge
nodes.rationale: RpcApp type as single contract; TypeBox at transport; same Elysia app in preview server without mocks.

nodes.label: Decision 2 — TypeBox sole validation library
nodes.rationale: One schema dialect and error model across core YAML, config, and RPC; Zod removed.

nodes.label: Decision 3 — hand-written TypeBox RPC responses
nodes.rationale: Without drizzle-typebox, explicit response schemas mirror DB row types for auditable transport contracts.

nodes.label: Decision 4 — Fishery factories; no drizzle-seed
nodes.rationale: Factories stay pure and SQLite-agnostic; YAML fixtures only for ImportService e2e paths.

nodes.label: Decision 5 — bun:sqlite direct; Drizzle removed
nodes.rationale: Most query surface bypassed Drizzle for FTS5/virtual tables; raw SQL recovers performance and expressiveness with bounded hand-written upsert cost.

nodes.label: Stable identity (crc32(type:key))
nodes.rationale: Rebuild-stable ids keep deep links consistent across syncs.
